## Standard: **Land**

Standard

L1

[Create your badge here](https://sws.flaffipony.rocks?s=L1%20%20)

### Substandards

[**Car** (Smaller wheeled vehicles)](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Standards/Land/Car)

[**Truck** (Bigger wheeled vehicles)](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Standards/Land/Truck)

[**Train** (Vehicles moving on the rails/track system)](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Standards/Land/Train)

### Rules of this standard

- Rear light (red)
- Front light (white or yellow-white) **THIS RULE DOES NOT APPLY TO TRUCK TRAILERS OR CAR TRAILERS**

### Feature rules

- see [global feature rules](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Standards/Features)

### Size rules

- None - This standard does not have any size dependent rules
